snippet.title: Pixel Formation – Gameplay Teaser | Ancient Pixel Art Tactics
snippet.description:
546 BC. A Phocaean crew, cut off from home, lands on a hostile coast.
Pixel Formation is a tactical game about one ship's company in the ancient Mediterranean
Sail uncharted waters, make camp before the clash, and fight as one formation.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929700/

Music: Joseph Burdock – https://www.youtube.com/@joseph_burdock

#PixelFormation #pixelart #indiegame #tactics #strategy #ancientgreece #gamedev
